utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So good afternoon, everybody, and welcome to this Status Conference. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case IT-04-74-A, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. I just want to make sure before we proceed that each one of the appellants can follow -- is in a position to follow the proceedings in a language that you can understand. I'll start with Mr. Prlic. THE APPELLANT PRLIC: Good afternoon, Mr. President. I hear and I am able to follow the conference.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Prlic. Mr. Stojic. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay, thank you. Mr. Praljak. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] I can hear you and understand you. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] I can hear you and understand you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Could I have appearances for the parties now, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FADEM
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. On behalf of the Prosecution, Luke Fadem, assisted by senior Appeals counsel Barbara Goy, case manager Colin Nawrot, and legal intern Lejla Korjenic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Defence. Defence for --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Michael Karnavas for Dr. Prlic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Senka Nozica, as counsel and Ms. Martin as co-counsel on behalf of Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. PINTER
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. On behalf of General Praljak, Nika Pinter appearing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. Vesna Alaburic appearing for General Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Drazen Plavec, co-counsel, appearing for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Incidentally, let's go into private session for a while, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, madam. Yes, I would like to have the appearances for Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Via videolink] [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Mr. Ibrisimovic, attorney-at-law from Sarajevo, appearing for Mr. Pusic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. Following an election by the Plenary of Judges of this Tribunal, I took over the Presidency from Judge Meron on 17 November 2015, and by operation of the Statute of this Tribunal, I consequently became the Presiding Judge of these appeal proceedings, whether you like it or not. On 18 November 2015, pursuant to Rules 65 ter and 107 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal, I designated myself as Pre-Appeal Judge, and in that capacity, I am conducting the Status Conference today. This Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis(B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal. This Rule requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference has been held for each of the appellants in the Tribunal's custody. By the way, Mr. Ibrisimovic, are you following me?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Via videolink] [Interpretation] Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes. First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions, and for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. Second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their cases as well as to inform the general public thereof. I note that the last Status Conference was held on 2nd September of this year, and today's Status Conference was scheduled by an order issued on the 22nd of October, 2015. I turn now to the first major item on today's agenda. Namely, the situation and health of each one of the appellants. I'd like to inquire into the -- particularly into the status of detention conditions and health situations of each one of you. If any of the appellants present here wishes, this discussion can take place in a closed session. And therefore, my first question to you is -- to your representatives, would any one of you like to have this matter discussed in private or closed session? I hear no declaration. And counsel for Mr. Pusic?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Via videolink] [Interpretation] Your Honour, should we discuss Mr. Pusic's state of health, then I would kindly ask that we move into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. So I take it that as regards all the other appellants, there's no request or no particular remarks or submissions regarding detention and health situation; is that correct? Okay. I hear no comments. So let's go into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. There being no further remarks on the issue of detention and health of the appellants, I now will proceed to recent procedural history. All of the appellants' briefs in this case were filed on 12 January of this year, and all of the Defence and Prosecution respondent's briefs were filed on 7th May of this year. The Defence and Prosecution's reply briefs were filed on the 29th of May of this year. Since the previous Status Conference, I can note that public redacted versions of reply briefs were filed by 9th September 2015, with the exception of Mr. Pusic's reply brief. On the 21st of October, 2015, however, Mr. Pusic's reply and response briefs as well as Mr. Petkovic's response brief were reclassified from confidential to public. This means that all public redacted versions of appeal briefs, response briefs, and reply briefs are now with the Court. Lastly, following a motion from the Prosecution, Exhibit P02921 was reclassified from confidential to public on the 10th of November, 2015. I am also informing that you there are no public motions pending before the Appeals Chamber, and there are a couple of confidential motions that are being dealt with about which I cannot give details because of the aspect of confidentiality, but eventually you will be informed. I come to -- yes, I also must inform you that Mr. Coric today waived his right to be present. Thank you. At this point, I have nothing left except to ask the parties whether there are any issues that they would like to raise. I will start with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FADEM
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. Do any of the appellants have any other issue they would like to raise? I ask counsel first.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Nothing, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Microphone not activated].

utterances.speaker: MS. PINTER
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There are no problems, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is nothing to raise, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Via videolink] [Interpretation] There is nothing, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So that is about it. I think I can conclude today's Status Conference. Once more, I wish to thank you for your attendance and for your co-operation. Just to put your mind at rest, having assumed the Presidency of this Tribunal, your appeal is top on my agenda. And as soon as I have settled in properly and have organised the team working on your appeal, I'll make sure that everything works according to plan, and we will keep you informed as we go along. Thank you very much and have a nice afternoon. Thank you.

procedural_notes.text: [The appellants Coric and Pusic not present]
